card.name: Start of 'Hormonal' after a sentence break
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word 'Hormonal' ("Horm") starting a new heading or entry right after a sentence ends, mostly in drug-interaction lists. Weaker cases are the first part of a name such as Harald or John, or a linking word in cancer-treatment text.
